reviewer: animation_renderer agent; actual source/reference/three Blender renders inspected
cameraAndViewport: Three recorded orthographic Blender Cycles cameras, 1280x1280, 48 samples. Gameplay is an elevated review camera, not proof of the integrated game camera.

technical_import.reason: 49,970 triangles and three packed 4096x4096 textures imported and rendered; original GLB SHA256 unchanged. Geometry/material nodes preserved.

identity_and_silhouette.reason: Recognizable match to the generated generic cottage reference, but the intended Pallet Town player house has a left-of-center entrance and a different roof/front silhouette. The generated reference already contains this mismatch.

proportions_and_scale.reason: Dimensions 0.709469 x 0.786045 x 0.777041 in imported Blender units. Physical scale and ROM-to-building correspondence are not established; no corrective deformation applied.

material_response.reason: Roof has broad bright glossy streaks and softened/wrinkled tiles relative to the crisp, restrained terracotta reference. Timber/window trim also looks rounded and smeared.

construction_detail.reason: Main ridge/end caps and tile seams are lumpy; porch roof rows partially merge into an irregular sheet. A single fused triangle mesh does not preserve separately editable construction elements.

backside_completion.reason: Actual back render shows a closed building volume with a continuous rear roof and plain rear/left walls, not an open front-only shell. Diagnostic UV-seam weld found zero boundary or nonmanifold edges.

backside_correctness.reason: Neither the generated reference nor the top-down ROM image specifies unseen rear details. Blank rear walls are inferred generation content, not verified source accuracy.

scene_readability_and_lighting.reason: Cottage remains recognizable in the elevated review view, but the roof dominates. Integrated town camera, door/collision registration and environmental lighting still require review.

motion_and_contact.reason: Static exterior building; no animated door or interior was requested in this bounded review.

source_state_and_variant_coverage.reason: The intended player-house entrance is source tile x=6 inside building x=5..9, left of center. Candidate door is on the right. It must not be accepted merely by stretching the candidate into that footprint.

defects.symptom: Candidate doorway sits right of center; player-house source doorway is left of center.
defects.consequence: A rendered entrance would disagree with the original warp/interaction location.
defects.nextAction: Author a source-aligned facade/door anchor from the verified map and regenerate or remodel the building; validate registration in the actual town view.

defects.symptom: Candidate exposes a triangular front gable; source presents a broad horizontal eave/roof-plane silhouette with a different ridge orientation.
defects.consequence: Identity and gameplay-camera silhouette are wrong before fine materials are considered.
defects.nextAction: Correct the reference and main roof axis/shape from the source elevation before adding detail.

defects.location: Main ridge, both slopes, porch canopy
defects.symptom: Rounded swollen ridge caps, warped tile rows and wrinkled porch tiles lack crisp construction.
defects.consequence: Model reads as a softened maquette at review distance.
defects.nextAction: Rebuild roof panels/ridge/tile rows with repeatable construction geometry; preserve varied surface wear separately from silhouette.

defects.evidence: front.png and gameplay.png compared with cottage-v1.png
defects.symptom: Broad white glossy streaks and smeared wood/edge detail depart from the rougher, sharply built reference.
defects.consequence: Material appearance remains stylized and plasticky.
defects.nextAction: Review roughness/normal/specular maps under matched neutral lighting; re-author overly broad baked detail instead of only increasing texture resolution.

defects.symptom: Closed blank plaster walls with no rear openings; unseen surfaces are invented.
defects.consequence: Backside existence is proven, but architectural/source correctness is not.
defects.nextAction: Choose explicit rear construction requirements if those views are reachable, then compare a revised model from all accessible cameras.

placement.physicalScale: Unverified normalized units. A 6-meter illustrative target height would need uniform scale 7.7216; this is not an approved gameplay scale and was not applied.

limitations: Editable means a packed imported triangulated mesh, not a parametric architectural model.
One fused mesh/material; door, panes, gutters and roof tiles are not separated as gameplay parts.
Windows are opaque material surfaces; no verified room interior or glass transmission.
No app code, ROM state, candidate geometry or original GLB was changed.
No fidelity percentage or release acceptance is inferred from triangle count, packed textures or clean import.
nextAction: Revise the building/reference around the verified player-house entrance and roof silhouette, then repair roof construction/material response and repeat review in the live town camera.
